book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Nhwano ghwa chekwa ya kutolela
Yesu kakilongela nabho kangi kwa mihwano, kakiaghombela,
“Ghubhutwa ghwa kunane ghungulihwana na mutwa ywakantendekelehite mwana ywake mulyo ghwa chekwa ya kutolela.
Kakialaghila andumindumi bhake abhakema bhala bhaalalikitwe mu chekwa ya kutolela, peni bhakilema kuhika.

Mbole kakialaghila andumindumi bhangi pakalongela, ‘Mubhaghombele bhala bhaalalikitwi kukita chekwa yibhegha kala kwakya mwenga, njinja kala likambako lya senga na bhana bha senga bhanakuhata na hyakupechula.’
Peni bhombe bhakilema, na bhakighenda, ayu kunng'unda ghwake, na yungi ku utendehi ghwake,
amoo bhangi bhakiakamula bhala andumindumi bhake na bhakiatendela ndendelo ya honi na kuakoma.
Yula mutwa kakikalala muno, kakialaghila machonda bhake bhakaakanjaghane bhala bhanakukoma na kukiyocha mwoto kitami kyabhe.
Mbole, kakiaghombela andumindumi bhake, ‘Chekwa ya kutolela yibhegha kala, peni bhala bhanualalikite bhakiyitikila ng'obhe kuhika.
Basi, nng'ende mu ngongano ya njila na mukaalalike bhohele bhamubhabhona, bahahike mu mulyo ghwa chekwa ya kutolela.’
Bhala andumindumi bhakighenda mu njila na bhakiakungana bhandu bhoha bhaakonganite nabho, bhandu bha maha na ahakata, na lubhagha lwoha lwa chekwa lukimema ahenja.”
“Peni mutwa pakayingilite unyumba ngati kabhabhone ahenja, amwo kakimmona mundu yumu kahwala ng'obhe lipinda liinoghwa mu chekwa ya kutolela.
Mutwa kakinkonya, ‘Ghanja, ghukiyingila bhuli amu kyanga kuhwala lipinda lya kutolela?’ Yula mundu kakitama jii.
Ndo mutwa kakiaghombela andumindumi bhake, ‘Mummope mabhoko na maghulu na mukantaghe panje mulubhindu. Akwo kwabhegha na kililo na kuhyagha mino.’ ”
Yesu kakiyomola pakilongela, “Kiyaha bhaalalikitwe atangalo, peni bhahaghulitwe bhamandina.”
Kuhomba sumu kwa Mutwa ywa Akaaloma
Mbole, Akaafalisayo bhakibhuka panji, na bhakighambelana atende niki kwakya kung'omeha Yesu kwa malagho ghake.

Ndo bhakialaghila afwasi bhabhe papamu na bhandu bha kimati kya Helode nabho bhakinnkonya, “Nhunda, tungukumanya kukita ghwenga ndo mundu ywa maha, na kukita ghunguhunda njila ya Chapanga ya kutenda gha maha kyangali kummaghula mundu.
Basi, ghutughombele, ghwenga ghunguhwacha bhuli? Tungunoghwa kunhomba sumu mutwa nkulu ywa Akaaloma ebu chepa?”
Peni Yesu kakimanya mahwachilo ghabhe gha uhakata kakiaghombela, “Mwenga maafyangu, kiyaha niki mungupala kundegha?
Mummonehe ligwala lya kuhomba sumu.” Bhakinnyeghela ligwala liikemwa dinali,
naywo kakiakonya, “Kibhungi aki na lihina ali ndo lya ghani?”
Bhakinnyanga, “Lya mutwa nkulu ywa Akaaloma.” Ndo Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mumpeghe mutwa nkulu ywa Akaaloma ghaabheghite gha Ywombe, na gha Chapanga mumpeghe ghaabheghite gha Chapanga.”
Paayihwite agho bhakikangacha, ndo bhakibhuka na bhakinneka.
Yesu kungunywa nhalo ghwa kuhyuka
Linjubha alyo alyo Asadukayo, bhala bhaalongela kukita kahone kuhyuka kuhumu kwa bhaahweghite, bhakinhikila Yesu na kunkonya ngonyo paalongela,
“Nhunda, Musa kakilongela, ‘Handa mundu pakahwegha kyanga bhana, nnongo ghwake kantole aywo nhumbu nnekwa ngati kampeghe bhana aywo nnongo ghwake ywakahweghite.’
Hino, apa kwa twenga pakibhegha na alongo saba. Yula ywa kalongohi kakitolela nhumbu, naywo kakihwegha kyangali bhana, ndo nnung'una ywake kakinhala aywo nhumbu.
Yikibhegha ubhwabhu abhu kwa yula nnongo ywa ubhili na ywa ndatu, mbaka bhoha saba.
Mbole, yula nhumbu naywo kakihwegha.
Bhuli, linjubha lya kuhyuka, nhumbu aywo katabhegha nhumbu ywa ghani mu bhala alongo saba? Kiyaha bhoha bhakintola nhumbu aywo.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Mwenga munguhokela kiyaha mungumanya ng'obhe Malembo ebu likalama lya Chapanga.
Kiyaha bhaahweghiti paapala kuhyuka bhaatolela kata ebu kutolelwa, ngati bhaabhegha handa mahoka bha Chapanga.
Peni kwa ghula nnando ghwa bhandu kuhyuka mukisoma ng'obhe kila kyakalongilite Chapanga kukita,
‘Nenga ndo Chapanga ywa Iblahimu, Chapanga ywa Isaka, na Chapanga ywa Yakobu?’ Ywombe chepa Chapanga ywa bhaahweghite, ngati ndo Chapanga ywa bhaabheghite na ubhumi.”
Lula lumati lwa bhandu paluyihwite agho, lukikangacha muno kwa mahundo ghake.
Ngwilikiho ngulu
Afalisayo paayihwite kukita Yesu kakianyamahia, bhala Asadukayo, bakikonganika papamu.
Yumoo ywa bhala ahunda bha Malaghilo, kakinkonya likonyo ngati kanteghe, pakalongela,
“Nhunda, ndo ngwilikiho yoki Mumalaghilo yiibheghite ngulu kupitingana hyoha?”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Ghunpale Bambo Chapanga ywako kwa mwoyo ghwako ghwoha na kwa mwoyo ghwako ghwoha na kwa mahala ghako ghoha.
Ayi ndo Ngwilikiho yinakunoghwa na kangi ya ulongohi.
Na ya ubhili ndo handa ayi, nalyo ndo ali, ‘Ghumpale nndamani ywako handa paghughupala ntima ghwako.’
Ngwilikiho ahi mbili hikamulilwa Mumalaghilo ghoha na ambuye bha Chapanga.”
Ngonyo kulinga Kilisto Nkombohi
Afalisayo paakwemukiti papamu, Yesu kakiakonya,
“Munguhwacha niki kunninga Kilisto Nkombohi? Ywombe ndo Mwana ywa ghani?” Bbombe bhakinnyanga, “Ywombe ndo Mwana ywa Daudi.”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Yibhegha bhuli aywo Daudi pakalongohitwe na Nhuki ywa Chapanga kangunkema Kilisto, ‘Bambo?’ Kiyaha kakilongela,

content.text: ghutame mu mbande yanenga ya nnilo,
Mbaka paambala kubhahotola yomo amyanja bhako.’

content: Handa Daudi kangunkema Kilisto, ‘Bambo’ Yibhegha bhuli Kilisto kabheghe mwana ywa Daudi?”
Kahone mundu ywakahotolite kunnyanga lilagho. Kutandila linjubha alyo kahone mundu ywakayighite kunkonya kangi.
